frontend.line: Sign-in redirect loop: login page is app/login/page.tsx (Clerk SignIn, path routing /login, redirect /dashboard); /login and any new public page must be in publicRoutes in middleware.ts. Staging loop from PR #828 is Lena's.

Money: format via formatMoney (apps/web/lib/money.ts) which rounds on decimal string (Number(`${amount}e2`)) since Math.round(amount*100) gave 2.005 -> 2.00; most callers pass cents/100, proper fix is formatting from integer cents; round each line to whole cents before summing.

No emojis in code, commit messages or docs.
CLI errors: throw UsageError (exit 2) for bad flags, never process.exit in handlers; others print message and exit 1 (packages/cli/src/lib/errors.ts).
Components under 150 lines with colocated tests; re-check for bugs/security before done.
API errors: RFC 7807 problem+json via problem() (apps/api/src/lib/problem.ts) incl. 400/404/409; soft delete with deleted_at, never hard delete.
Money stored as integer cents (amount_cents bigint), never floats; list endpoints use cursor pagination, never offset.
Standing rule: for any large refactor, show a plan first and wait for explicit approval before touching code.
TypeScript style: 2-space indent, single quotes, semicolons, external imports first then local.
Git hooks via lefthook (lefthook.yml); husky removed 2026-09-29; remove any leftover .husky references.
New tables: UUID v7 PKs via uuidv7() in drizzle $defaultFn (not serial, not v4); include org_id, created_at, deleted_at and an index on org_id.

jobs.line: Acme moved off RabbitMQ: worker consumes BullMQ queues on Redis 7; Bull Board at /admin/queues on worker (basic auth), link that. Run locally: redis + `pnpm --filter worker dev`, metrics 9464.
Retry policy (queue/retry.ts, all consumers): maxRetries 3, backoff 1s/2s/4s, then DLQ (+Slack #alerts); ack after write. Supersedes 5 attempts.
Worker concurrency 5 per process (WORKER_CONCURRENCY, queues.ts); for month-end backlog raise max replicas, not per-process concurrency.

Worker shutdown on SIGTERM: stops taking jobs, drains in-flight 30s (GRACE_PERIOD_MS), helm terminationGracePeriodSeconds 30; image-resize jobs can exceed it and w.close() may pick up one more job; Priya says it's on our side; fix (pause before close; 90s/100s) not made.

Every worker job handler must be idempotent using job id as key (webhooks: redis idem:webhooks:<job id> SET NX, done after success, 24h expiry).
Queues: email, images, billing-sync, webhooks (QUEUE_NAMES in queues.ts). Bug: apps/api/src/jobs/enqueue.ts:31 enqueues "billing_sync" (underscore) so jobs are silently dropped; unfixed.

Grafana queues.json has 'billing-sync queue depth' panel (bullmq waiting+active); dry-run clean, not pushed.

api.line: API is Fastify 5 (Express 4 migrated away, PR #412): plugins in apps/api/src/plugins/ (auth, cors, rate-limit, request-id, error-handler); handlers (request, reply); routes versioned under /v1 (paths without /v1 are wrong).

Every table has org_id; every query must filter by req.auth.orgId. JSON camelCase (totalCents); convert SUM() DECIMAL strings to numbers.

Cursor pagination (opaque cursor on created_at + id), never offset; decode cursor createdAt to Date for timestamptz comparisons (decodeCursor in lib/cursor.ts; InvalidCursorError = 400) else index unused.
Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json via problem() helper (lib/problem.ts); rows soft-deleted via deleted_at, lists/gets filter deleted_at IS NULL.
Money integer cents; invoices/totals.ts rounds each line's net and tax to whole cents then sums (fixed Northwind 1-cent mismatch); issued invoices keep stored totals.
